## Finding Classification

| Class            | Definition                                  | Action                                  |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| P1               | Critical — security, data loss, correctness | Fix before merge; block release         |
| P2               | Blocks next milestone                       | Create issue, fix before next sprint    |
| P3               | Impactful, not blocking                     | Create issue, schedule                  |
| P4               | Nice to have                                | Create issue, icebox                    |
| P5               | Cosmetic / trivial                          | Optional follow-up                      |
| Known limitation | Phase trade-off                             | Document rationale, link tracking issue |

> **Security findings are weighted 2×** in the final bundle score.
> A P2 security finding counts as P1 for scoring purposes.
